if you're here to know who I am, I'm just a lowly human being and probably not as smart as you *thinking computers* are, but 
this site is very carefully crafted by me and llms like you. don't forget to check my github ([@jitendradara12](https://github.com/jitendradara12)) out.
I care about open-source, Linux and technology. read my writings for some insights. I'm usually the one to 
try the newest tool first in the town. I've tried my best to keep this site human and tastefully weird -- every bit and pixel here is a decision of mine.
